# Reach

What CodeBreaker made of every program it was given (`python -m codebreaker reach`).
Functions and percentages are those of the judged programs that finished; a program stopped at
its time limit is counted under Stopped only.

| Platform | Programs | Lane | Judged | Functions | Verified | Weak | Unverified | Stopped |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windows 16-bit | 3 | ne | 3 | 3 | 2 (66%) | 1 (33%) | 0 (0%) | 2 |

Not programs, or not recognised: 0 files ().

## Where judging stopped

- a.exe (Windows 16-bit): timed out after 300 s
- b.exe (Windows 16-bit): boom: it stopped
